objective: Resolve exact pinned content into an immutable, deterministic and policy-checked authored preset preview; independently verify native private-directory inputs.
decisions: Reuse the compiled authored schema validator and command 0.2 prepare_authored path; add no second settings engine or runtime schema retrieval.
Require both selected package-manifest and preset-document pins. Dependencies pin manifests; preset references pin exact entry bytes within their owning closure.
Validate bounded packages/assets, exact size/digest totals, canonical portable paths, schema semantics, dependency depth and document ambiguity before producing a plan.
Resolve parent settings from root to leaf, validate even shadowed values, and retain winning preset pins and original immutable package bytes.

A leaf theme pin overrides its candidate scene; a null leaf theme preserves the scene choice, and null scene theme inherits effective application settings. Never inherit a parent theme through null or choose a latest version implicitly.
Normalize only the materialized scene revision, then validate/authorize the preview under exact current policy and authenticated role. Import supplies no capability grant.
Read explicit Linux private package directories through held no-follow handles. Reject links, special/executable files, permissions, undeclared entries and observed read changes.
Compare complete native output and independently computed hashes; mutate a real file after catalog construction to prove snapshot ownership and subsequent fresh-read refusal.
Retain W-08 and all five release tracks as incomplete. Durable resources, installed ownership, media decoding, activation and non-Linux readers remain required.

open_questions: Exact oldest Windows 9x, Windows NT and Mac OS X versions/service levels and CPU architectures remain awaiting clarification.
Designated historical/Windows and Mac laboratories remain unresolved; existing user desktops and unrelated VMs are not admitted by implication.
next_step: Persist and recover the exact prepared resource closure with each generation; close installed controller/store/protected-policy ownership and connect native settings, direct editing and actual activation. Continue all five release tracks.
authority_used: User instruction to commit and sync main
limitations: Pinned content preview and explicit private Linux directory reading only. No full installed product or release qualification.
The current native generation store still admits only its built-in resource fixture. External resource plans are not durable commits or activation evidence.
Opaque media bytes are hashed but not decoded. Archive import, widget packages, three-way preset updates, reset/tombstones and complete layer provenance remain open.
Current command 0.2 retains its 16 KiB ceiling, separate from the 256 KiB content document ceiling.
Linux snapshot ownership does not prove filesystem power-loss durability, source authenticity or permission to execute content.
Historical toolset execution on the modern Windows host does not establish Windows 9x/XP/old NT support. Non-Linux native content readers remain open.
Two existing Windows symlink assertions remain skipped. No privileged operation, user desktop/VM operation or public release occurred.
